EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 10
EPISODE LOGLINE: On Friday Nadia exposes the scheme before the shareholders and Grant is arrested, but the chairman has a plan.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picking up at the Episode 9 cliffhanger: the transfer orders carry Arthur Kellan's signature.

--- SCRIPT START ---

Start: (00:37.96) | End: (00:42.50)

Start: (00:42.90) | End: (00:47.50)

**GRANT (Shouting, Furious):**
Start: (00:47.80) | End: (00:53.02)
"You think I built this alone? Ask the chairman who signed the orders!"
